versions.content: If DemClearDtcNotificationTime is configured to FINISH , the Dem shall inform the application about the end of a clear DTC operation. The Dem shall consider the configuration parameter DemClearDTCBehavior which defines the clearing process of diagnostic information including clearing completion. If the Dem- ClearDtcNotificationFnc is configured, the Dem shall call this configured function otherwise the Dem shall call the R-Port ClearDtcNotification.
